name: pi-outliner
description: Pi Outliner integration for Claude Code, following the outline the session folder is bound to: typed outline, workboard and door tools for agents (read, find, edit, comment, changes, draft.patch, ep0ch act), clickable references, and completed responses that mention [[pages]], ((block ids)) or Work IDs in the Outliner's Recent Mentions navigator.

workspaces.title: Outliner folders (opt-outs, or the strict allowlist)
workspaces.description: Absolute folders, separated by ':' or ','. Sessions in them (and their subfolders) feed no outline, even when bound to one. In allowlist mode, instead only they feed (strict mode, as before folder mode). Empty: PI_OUTLINER_MENTIONS_WORKSPACES applies.

mode.title: How a session finds its outline
mode.description: folder: each session feeds the outline its folder's nearest bound ancestor names (its client.json, or an outline root the host serves); an unbound folder feeds nothing, and listed folders are opted out. allowlist: only the listed folders feed, as before. Empty: PI_OUTLINER_MENTIONS_MODE applies; neither set: folder.
